QUIC API with config, callbacks, metrics, lifecycle, connection, stream, and packet functions.

# Purpose
This header file defines the public API and data types for `fd_quic_t`, a partial QUIC implementation for encrypted multiplexed transport over IPv4 and Ethernet. It declares the memory limits, layout, configuration, callback set, and metrics used to create, join, initialize, service, and destroy a QUIC object in pre-allocated memory. The file also declares the main connection and stream functions, packet processing entry points, and helper functions for network I/O and environment-based configuration. It is a central interface file for code that manages QUIC connections, stream send and receive events, and protocol service work.
